answer: Make every identity one vertex in an attestation graph. To earn influence, a vertex must hold a sable seal: a dark receipt proving it sits on a fresh vertex-disjoint trust path from an independent root, sharing no vertex with any other sealed identity. A ledge caps each root: the k-th identity from one root must open k new disjoint paths, so N clones pay for 1+2+...+N segments while one honest agent pays for one. A random audit lights one path; if two seals share a vertex, both burn and the root loses its stake. One seal, one path; a clone factory pays a quadratic pile of paths for one share.
